sloka: न अतिक्रान्तम् मुनिश्रेष्ठ यत् कर्तव्यम् कृतम् मया ।संगता मुनिना पत्नी भार्गवेण इव रेणुका ॥१-५१-११॥
transliteration: na atikrāntam muniśreṣṭha yat kartavyam kṛtam mayā ।saṁgatā muninā patnī bhārgaveṇa iva reṇukā ॥1-51-11॥

translations.english: O Best of ascetics (Satananda) All that is required to be done has been done and nothing was omitted. Ahalya was united with sage Gautama like Renuka with Jamadagni.
